proposition: Niʿmatullahi hagiographical sources record that Niʿmat Allāh Valī and Qāsim-i Anvār accompanied Ibn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn on a visit to Akhlāṭī, and that Niʿmat Allāh had told them to seek Akhlāṭī out in the first place.

mediation.note: the sources credit their own saint with the careers of Ibn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn
